messages:
alex (CSM): quick weekly check-in for Acme — noticed the canary to new model 'redwood-open-2-qa' ramped to ~42% token volume after 72h. New-model success rate 93.3% but fallback rate jumped to 6.7% (baseline 1.1%). 95th latency +120ms. Spend +18% WoW. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/dash/acme/model-mix

maria (AE): thanks alex. renewal in ~6 weeks — should we flag this as a renewal risk if fallbacks persist? :thinking:

sam (ML Eng): assigning quick triage. Hypothesis: tokenizer mismatch + quantization fallback on long sequences. Can you paste 2 failing request examples? tagging @ops-bot for trace dump.

ops-bot: [alert] Fallback spike detected for acme-prod at 2025-11-05T14:02Z. 5-min fallback rate: 8.1%. Deployment: canary/redwood-open-2-qa (rev: 20251105-3).

alex (CSM): pasted two anonymized payloads below — one has system prompt >2k chars, other is short. Most fallbacks are from user-agent 'mobile-sdk/1.3.2'.

sam (ML Eng): thanks. quick check, run:
```
rdwctl logs acme --filter "fallback" --since 15m --tail 200
rdwctl dump-requests --ids 4852,4853 --format jsonl
```
I see retries hitting model timeout then falling back. Instrumenting the >256 token path and cold KV startup cost.

jess_b (Product): was the canary routing by region or latency? if it's region skewed maybe mobile clients in region X are hitting canary more. Also confirm canary weight — 30% or 50%?

oliver (CS Ops): suggested remediation steps: 1) reduce canary weight to 10%; 2) enable prefix KV caching for the canary model; 3) add temporary fallback-timeout override to 10s. I can apply 1 & 3 now if eng approves.

maria (AE): I'll reach out to Acme PO and set expectations. If we reduce weight, we'll call it a temporary mitigation and offer a timeline.

sam (ML Eng): agreed. I'll deploy a short-term circuit to avoid cold-KV startup on first token and add extra logging for mobile-sdk requests. Pushing flag now.

alex (CSM): thanks team. Oliver, please proceed with weight change once sam confirms the flag is active. I'll update Acme in the PM sync. :thumbsup:
